prefix.description: SEL-587Z High-Impedance Differential Relay (part number begins 0587Z)

part_number.note: 15-digit MOT string measured directly from WI-2772 page 1 (Part Number template 0 5 8 7 Z 0 [ ][ ][ ][ ][ ] 2 X X). Positions: 6 firmware (fixed 0), 7 conformal coat, 8 power supply/control-input voltage (combined single digit), 9 energy-clamping MOVs, 10 secondary input current, 11 mounting, 12 communications port, 13 communications protocol (fixed 2 = Standard Plus Modbus RTU), 14-15 trailing fixed X digits. This model has NO drawing layers (model_to_layers.has_layers=false), so positions were calibrated against genuine part numbers: the SEL-587Z IM reports PARTNO=0587ZXXXX5XX2XX (position 10=5 -> 5 A Phase, position 13=2 -> Modbus, trailing X X), and the two device drawing-selection strings 0587Z0X111312XX / 0587Z0X111H12XX (differing only at position 11 mounting, 3=Panel vs H=Rack) decode to all-valid options, confirming the column map.

example_part_numbers.note: Drawing-selection example (front i3481b): Standard firmware, No conformal coat, 24 Vdc PS/24 Vdc control, 1 MOV (2500 J), 1 A phase, Horizontal Panel Mount, EIA-232 front and rear, Standard Plus Modbus RTU. Decodes cleanly against this block.
Drawing-selection example (front i3483b): identical to above but position 11 = H (Horizontal Rack Mount).
Generic template as reported by the relay's PARTNO command in the SEL-587Z IM; configurable positions shown as X, with 5 A phase (pos 10) and Modbus (pos 13).

positions.label: Firmware
positions.note: Only one firmware option is offered; this digit is fixed at 0.

positions.label: Power Supply; Control Input Voltage
positions.note: Single digit encoding the paired power-supply and control-input-voltage combination. Control input voltage is jumper-selectable (24/48/125/250 Vdc); the factory sets jumpers to match the option ordered.

positions.label: Communications Port
positions.note: EIA-485 is for special applications only; SEL strongly recommends EIA-232. An EIA-485 order ships with an SEL-C675 Terminal Adapter (DB-9 to 8-pin screw terminal).

options.2: EIA-232 Front Port and EIA-485 Rear Port

positions.label: Communications Protocol
positions.note: Only one protocol option is offered; this digit is fixed at 2.

positions.label: Reserved
positions.note: Trailing fixed digit; the WI-2772 template shows X and all known part numbers carry X here.
